newsitem.title: GERMANY: FOCUS - Volksfuersorge unit plans to raise capital. [CORRECTED 15:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - Volksfuersorge unit plans to raise capital. [CORRECTED 15:15 GMT]

text.p: German insurer Volksfuersorge Holding AG said on Thursday that its non-life subsidiary Volksfuersorge Deutsche Sachversicherung planned a 140 million mark ($83 million) capital increase.
In a compulsory statement the group said its non-life unit planned to raise its dividend to 12.50 marks (Corrects from 12.90 marks) per share for 1996 from 12 marks a year ago.

The group decided at its annual shareholders meeting to raise capital in the group by 14 million to 154 million marks using a cash injection of 140 million marks. The capital increase will involve the issue of 280,000 new shares at 50 marks each

The new shares will be issued to shareholders on a 10 to one basis, based on their current shareholdings, at a price of 75 marks per share. Shareholders will be entitled to earnings from January 1 1997.
Volksfuersorge is majority-owned by Aachener und Muenchener Beteiligungs-Aktiengesellschaft AG.
Volksfuersorge Deutsche Sachversicherung AG reported unchanged premium income of 1.19 billion marks last year due to a decline in premiums for motor vehicle insurance.
